shouldFix.title: The version bump to 4 creates a new collision with component-sdk-contract.v4, leaving three bare `v4` references that can read as self-reference to g20-fixture-corpus.v4.
shouldFix.detail: The current basedOn role says `Applying v4 is a later D-000 act. g20-fixture-corpus.v4 does not adopt v4 SF-* identifiers as member ids.` Read as an independently consumed role field, both bare tokens can denote the subject itself rather than component-sdk-contract.v4. The same inherited shorthand remains in whatIsNotAuthored (`v4 SF-*`) and in the standalone failsIf entry (`v4 SF-*`). These are the only three bare `v4` string leaves in the subject.
shouldFix.whyThisIsNewAtV4: At g20-fixture-corpus.v3, the same shorthand could only denote the cited component-sdk-contract.v4 because the corpus speaker was version 3. Retargeting the speaker to g20-fixture-corpus.v4 created the collision. This is the same current-standing version-referent defect family that CLAUDE-G20FX-V3-S-1 identified for provider-only-output-contract.v3, even though the requested d136 repair itself is correctly landed.
shouldFix.whyItMatters: The v4 candidate explicitly adopts a full-name anti-collision rule for provider-only-output-contract.v3, but leaves an equally colliding component contract in shorthand. A reader of basedOn.componentSdkContractV4.role alone gets a literal statement about applying v4 and about the subject not adopting its own v4 identifiers, rather than the intended statement that component-sdk-contract.v4 remains unapplied and its SF-* identifiers are not adopted.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: The component contract path, digest, basedOn key, SF-* vocabulary, status, and binds fields make the intended referent recoverable; component-sdk-contract.v4 is not actually applied, the candidate binds NOTHING, and no fixture or authority claim changes. This is a successor wording/attribution defect, not a semantic application of the SDK contract.
shouldFix.repairShape: Replace each bare component-contract `v4` token with `component-sdk-contract.v4`. In basedOn.componentSdkContractV4.role, fully qualify both occurrences and optionally append `Not this artifact's version number.` Apply the same full qualification to whatIsNotAuthored[3] and failsIf[10]. Change no fixture, pin, obligation, or predecessor attribution.
